items.mainDefect: Synchronous device tagging makes anonymous authentication block on database operations.

secondary.defect: Using the request context allows request cancellation to abort device tagging.

items.mainDefect: Changing device tagging from fire-and-forget to synchronous makes anonymous authentication wait for database operations.

secondary.defect: ErrDeviceLimitReached now rejects anonymous authentication without updating callers to handle and translate the refusal.

items.mainDefect: Replacing the injected AnonStore with db.DB removes the ability to inject a fake or mock AnonStore.

secondary.defect: Existing callers and wire bindings that still supply AnonStore will fail compilation or dependency injection after the parameter changes to db.DB.
